description: A measurement or candidate offered as phase evidence, with its full envelope. Never an edge or a decision.

coordinates.description: Sample coordinates on the synthetic plate, if any.
coordinates.title: Coordinates

kind.description: measurement is computed from a source; candidate is a proposal (geometry link, traced lane, ranked pair) awaiting human review.
kind.title: Kind

mapping_digest.description: SHA-256 of the mapping that translated source fields.
mapping_digest.title: Mapping Digest

observed_at.description: Timezone-aware time the reading was taken.
observed_at.title: Observed At

phase_ref.description: Revision the reading is offered for.
phase_ref.title: Phase Ref

reading_id.description: Opaque reading id, referenced by events and decisions.
reading_id.title: Reading Id

source_version.description: Source version or revision the reading was taken from.
source_version.title: Source Version

tolerances.description: (name, non-negative tolerance) pairs used by the method.
tolerances.title: Tolerances

validity.description: valid, stale, failed, unknown or inaccessible. These stay distinct; none is zero.
validity.title: Validity

title: PhaseReading
